messages:
elaine: quick sync — i'm proposing adding 'ingress_affinity' to rollout metadata as a weak placement hint. intent: improve gateway-local KV cache hits for tenant pins, not to create hard routing.

samir: can you clarify "weak"? we need exact resolver semantics to avoid drift.

elaine: weak = only used when multiple candidates pass capacity checks. it acts as a tie-breaker with an optional integer priority (0-10). also add 'transition_seconds' to smooth changes.

matt: validation concerns: ids must be namespaced (prefix 'ingress-'), ascii lower/digits/dash, max 32 chars. control-plane manages registry. default behavior: reject unknown ids unless caller sets experimental flag.

maria: ops: migration-wise, changing hints can spike kv cache misses. require a per-rollout transition_seconds (default 600s). also add dashboards: ingress-locality-hit, kv-cache-miss-rate, p95-latency; alert if miss-rate increases > 25% post-change.

noah: example payload (inline): {"pin":"recommend-v4","ingress_affinity":"ingress-us-east-2","ingress_priority":"6","transition_seconds":"600","telemetry_opt_in":"ingress_affinity","expires_at":"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"}

samir: resolver pseudocode: 
```
if not capacity_ok(candidate): continue
score = base_score(candidate)
if candidate.ingress_id == hint.id:
  score += hint.priority * 3
else if candidate.region == hint.region:
  score += hint.priority
// transition_seconds -> linearly decay old->new weights during window
```

matt: one more: do not auto-generate hints from runtime telemetry for now. make it explicit and auditable.

ops-bot: schema-checker: pushed draft 'rollout-meta-v1.6-ingress-affinity' to staging. two legacy consumers flagged.

elaine: action items: matt -> schema + validator PR; samir -> implement tie-breaker behind runtime flag + unit tests; maria -> runbook + dashboards; noah -> add e2e test for transition_seconds. ops-bot: re-run after PRs.

maria: i'll also add a throttle: limit hint changes to X tenants/minute per org to avoid ripple effects.

elaine: thanks — we'll treat as opt-in for a few weeks and measure p95 improvements before wider rollout. :rocket:
